description: 多 Agent 服务器并发隔离性、单服务器高并发处理、共享函数并发安全

tests.name: TestConcurrent_MultipleServersIsolated
assertions: 5 个 Agent 服务器并发启动，/health 各返回自身身份
无跨 Agent 身份污染 (identity cross-contamination)
所有 status=ok

tests.name: TestConcurrent_MultipleServersAgentCardIsolated
assertions: 3 个服务器并发 AgentCard 请求，各返回自身 card.name
无卡名污染 (card.name cross-contamination)
版本号一致 (0.1.0)

tests.name: TestConcurrent_SingleServerParallelRequests
assertions: 40 并发请求全部成功 (0 errors)
身份一致性 (agent=example-agent-concurrent)

tests.name: TestConcurrent_BuildAgentCardParallel
assertions: 每个 card.Name 匹配输入 config.Name
无指针混叠 (pointer aliasing)
无跨 goroutine 污染

tests.name: TestConcurrent_NoopHandlerReentrant
assertions: 50 并发 health check 全部返回 200
NoopHandler 可重入安全

tests.name: TestConcurrent_MixedEndpointsParallel
assertions: 混合端点在并发下均返回正确身份
10 health + 10 agentcard 全部正确

tests.name: TestConcurrent_MultiAgentTaskIsolation
assertions: 3 Agent 并发 30 请求，无跨 Agent 身份污染
每个 agent 的 reported name 正确

tests.name: TestConcurrent_ValidateConfigParallel
assertions: ValidateConfig 在并发下正确区分 valid (0 errors) 和 invalid (>0 errors)
无数据竞争

tests.name: TestConcurrent_ServerStartupShutdown
assertions: 10 个服务器并发启动/请求/关闭，互不干扰
所有服务器均返回 200
